title: This Crocodile Grows a Giant Pot on Its Nose to Buzz

scenes.text: This crocodile has a giant pot on its nose. Females love it.
It's called the ghara, after an Indian clay pot. Only adult males grow one.
It sits over the nostrils and works like a speaker, turning calls into a loud buzz.
Males also blow bubbles to win over females.
Adults reach about fifteen feet long, with a thin snout built for catching fish.
And only about 650 adults are left in the wild. That buzz is getting rarer.
